resources.string: Calm and dark. Colours follow each album cover.
A city at night: lit skyline, wet street, your song on neon signs.
A sports dashboard: graphite, ice-blue LEDs, a red-lined rev counter.
A turntable under a spotlight. Your album is a picture disc.
Flowing northern lights and soft glass.
True black, big type, nothing else. Lightest on the processor.
Bright and high contrast for sunny days.
A chrome cassette: your album is the label, the tape winds with the song.
